For example, we directly solve only the step 3 problem, but we experienced convergence issues or local minimizers. From this we learned that the initial design is important for the convergence. We also tried to solve only Steps 1 and 3 but that algorithm had difficulty changing the spacing between toolpaths. We also tried the continuation method for β, wherein we start with a small β value and continuously increase its value after several iterations. Sadly, no advantages in the performance or the results were obtained. Ultimately, our three-step algorithm consistently produced good designs.
